Subject: Dedicated capacity inquiry — throughput and latency check

Hi Evelyn,

We signed up for the self-serve trial and are evaluating Redwood for a Dedicated deployment. Our primary goal is to serve clinical note summarization at scale — roughly 120–180 QPS steady during business hours, with tail latencies ideally <150ms and p50 closer to 80–100ms.

Can we do a short technical fit-check / demo focused on throughput and latency behavior on Dedicated capacity? We want to validate: 1) request/response latencies at our payload sizes, 2) how autoscaling and burst capacity behave, and 3) estimated cost per 1M tokens under a production pattern.

A couple of extra details attached (traffic_sample.csv) — it’s a very small sample of payload sizes and arrival distribution. Happy to include our infra/ops person if helpful — I’ve cc'd Lina on this thread.

Thanks,
Samir

Hi Samir — Marcus here (SE). Thanks for the sample and the traffic numbers — very helpful. I put together a short checklist so we can make the session actionable: see throughput-checklist.pdf attached.

High-level plan for the 45-minute call:
- 10 min: quick architecture & workload recap (participants, payload sizes, peak QPS)
- 20 min: live fit-check on Dedicated pre-config (we’ll run a controlled synthetic profile matching your CSV; we may use a reduced token count if wall-time would be too long)
- 10 min: discuss autoscale, burst config, and cost model implications
- 5 min: next steps and handoff (POC/Reserved capacity sizing)

Prep requests (small):
- Confirm whether payloads are batched server-side or per-request (your CSV looks per-request).
- Provide a rough percent distribution of short vs long requests (e.g., 70% <1k tokens, 30% >2k).

I’ve also dropped a Drive link with a micro-test plan: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/throughput-intake-COBALT

If Thu 5/24 09:00 ET is your preference, I’m available and will block 45 minutes on the calendar if you confirm.
